name: pynakes-vscode
description: Browse BibTeX/BibLaTeX bibliographies in VS Code, powered by the pynakes engine.

pynakes.executable.markdownDescription: Command used to invoke the pynakes engine. Leave empty to use the bundled engine, or an installed pynakes when it is newer. Setting this overrides discovery entirely; pair it with `#pynakes.executableArgs#` when it names a Python interpreter.

pynakes.executableArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments inserted before every pynakes subcommand. Set to `["-m", "pynakes"]` when `#pynakes.executable#` is a Python interpreter.

enumDescriptions: Use the bundled engine, unless an installed one is newer.
Always use the engine bundled with the extension.
Always use the pynakes found on PATH.
pynakes.engine.markdownDescription: Which pynakes engine to run. Ignored when `#pynakes.executable#` is set.

pynakes.search.fuzzy.markdownDescription: Start the view's search with `--fuzzy` enabled, matching misspellings and inflections by similarity. Can be toggled per search in the view.

pynakes.showFindings.markdownDescription: Show `lint` findings in the bibliography view: a severity marker per row and a findings panel. Findings are advisory and never change the file.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run vendor-engine && npm run compile
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for (const t of ['engine','out']) fs.rmSync(t,{recursive:true,force:true});for (const f of fs.readdirSync('.')) if (f.endsWith('.vsix')) fs.rmSync(f)"
